Hello,

Thank you for reaching out to Zycus Support. In accordance with system policy (KB-4859: Bulk approval limits), the bulk approval feature supports up to 200 documents per batch by design to safeguard audit trail integrity. As a workaround, please filter your PO list into batches of 200 or fewer to approve them. We have also forwarded your feedback regarding 500-batch approvals to our Product team as an enhancement request.
